POLICIES

Copyright & Corrections

Last updated November 19, 2026 · Version 1.0

We work to credit every photograph, video and article on this Site and to link to the original. If you own something that appears here, we want to hear from you.

If you own a photo, video or text on this Site

Email brett@brewerfamilycompanies.com with:

  1. The work you own, and the page on our Site where it appears.
  2. Your name and how to reach you.
  3. What you would like: correct credit, a link, licensing terms, or removal.
  4. A statement that you own the work or are authorized to act for the owner.

We will reply within 5 business days. While we review a removal request, we will take the item down if the claim appears valid.

Corrections to the history

If a date, name or detail is wrong, email brett@brewerfamilycompanies.com with your source. We review every correction and label details we cannot confirm.

Family archive

Photos marked “Brewer family archive” come from the Brewer family’s own collection. If you took one of these photos and want credit, let us know.

Questions? Email brett@brewerfamilycompanies.com.
